The contents of the form are not shared with the pixel. If you continue from the website to our Telegram bot and submit an enquiry there, our server tells Meta only that an enquiry was submitted, without its contents or your contact details. Your basket and anonymous identifier are stored in your browser's local storage (localStorage) and are not sent to our server on their own.

We start with a conversation: when it began, under what conditions and what work was done beforehand. Sometimes that already points to the cause: a knock only when cold and a constant knock can come from different components.

Next, we scan all control modules. A fault in the ABS or body control module can often explain the driver's complaint. Then we check the car itself: on the lift, checking for play and inspecting components under load, with pressure tests and an oscilloscope where needed.

Finally, we show you the cause on the car and explain it in plain English. If repairs are needed, we prepare an estimate straight away.

What it costs: fault code reading is free. Diagnostic charges only apply if we need to dismantle a component or put the car on a test rig. We tell you the price before starting, not at the end.

src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.00ead0e3c2959f97:
**BMW 116d at our workshop in Belgrade.**

This BMW 116d came to us for a comprehensive service and several repairs. When working on a BMW, understanding the engine's particular characteristics and paying attention to every detail is essential. We don't just replace parts, we look for the underlying cause of their failure.

**What work did we carry out on this BMW 116d?**

1. **Coolant replacement.** We replaced the coolant to keep the engine's cooling system working properly. Replacing coolant at the recommended intervals helps protect cooling system components from corrosion, maintain the correct operating temperature and prevent engine overheating.
2. **Lubrication of the exhaust backpressure valve for the EGR system.** We serviced the backpressure valve fitted in the exhaust pipe. This valve helps regulate exhaust backpressure and supports the operation of the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system on BMW diesel engines. Over time, the mechanism can become dirty, start to stick and stop working correctly. We lubricated the valve mechanism as required.
3. **Engine mount replacement.** We replaced a worn engine mount on the BMW 116d. Engine mounts secure the engine and reduce the vibrations transmitted to the body. Worn mounts can cause excessive vibration, reduced cabin comfort and additional stress on other components.
4. **Crankshaft vibration damper replacement required.** During the service, we also found that the crankshaft torsional vibration damper would need replacing. This component helps absorb torsional vibrations and keeps the auxiliary belt drive running smoothly. Replacing a worn damper should not be put off, as its failure can cause further damage and costly repairs.
src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.38ae27eddac8e4f1:
**BMW 116d u našem auto-servisu u Beogradu.**

Ovog puta kod nas je stigao BMW 116d kome su bili potrebni kompletno održavanje i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova. Kod BMW-a je važno poznavati specifičnosti motora i pažljivo pregledati svaki detalj: ne menjamo samo delove, već tražimo i uzrok njihovog otkazivanja.

**Koje smo radove obavili na BMW-u 116d?**

1. **Zamena antifriza.** Zamenili smo rashladnu tečnost kako bi sistem hlađenja motora pravilno radio. Pravovremena zamena antifriza štiti delove sistema od korozije, održava optimalnu radnu temperaturu i sprečava pregrevanje motora.
2. **Podmazivanje klapne za regulaciju protivpritiska izduvnih gasova u sklopu EGR sistema.** Servisirali smo klapnu smeštenu u izduvnoj cevi, koja učestvuje u regulaciji protivpritiska izduvnih gasova i radu sistema za recirkulaciju izduvnih gasova (EGR) kod BMW dizel motora. Vremenom se u mehanizmu mogu nakupiti nečistoće, zbog čega može da zapinje i ne radi pravilno. Obavili smo potrebno podmazivanje mehanizma klapne.
3. **Zamena nosača motora.** Zamenili smo dotrajali nosač motora na BMW-u 116d. Nosači drže motor na mestu i smanjuju prenos vibracija na karoseriju. Njihovo habanje može izazvati pojačane vibracije, neprijatnost u kabini i dodatno opterećenje drugih delova.
4. **Utvrđeno je da je potrebna zamena prigušivača torzionih vibracija.** Tokom servisa utvrdili smo i da će biti potrebno zameniti prigušivač torzionih vibracija radilice. Ovaj deo ublažava vibracije i obezbeđuje stabilan rad remenskog pogona pomoćnih agregata. Zamenu dotrajalog prigušivača ne treba odlagati, jer njegovo otkazivanje može dovesti do dodatnih kvarova i skupih popravki.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.e626523e71fec8d5:
This Audi A3 with a **150 hp 1.5 TFSI petrol engine** and a DQ200 dual-clutch gearbox came to our Russian-speaking garage in Belgrade for a major service. We replaced the timing belt.

Our diagnostics also identified a problem with the electric coolant pump, so we replaced that too. This is a separate component, and its replacement is unrelated to the major service or the timing belt. Testing showed that the pump's output had dropped and it was no longer circulating coolant properly. Rather than wait for this to affect engine temperature, we dealt with it straight away. We refilled the system with fresh coolant after the work.

At the same time, we carried out a minor service, replacing the engine oil and all the required filters.

Next was the gearbox. The DQ200 is a dry-clutch dual-clutch transmission. We changed the oil in the mechanical section and the hydraulic fluid in the mechatronic unit. Our recommendation for this gearbox is simple: change both fluids at least every **60,000 km**. Keeping to this interval helps the transmission last longer and reduces the likelihood of expensive repairs.
src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.f0e97063cf9ed621:
Audi A3 sa benzinskim motorom **1.5 TFSI od 150 KS** i robotizovanim menjačem DQ200 stigao je u naš ruski auto-servis u Beogradu na veliki servis. Zamenili smo zupčasti kaiš.

Na osnovu dijagnostike zamenili smo i električnu pumpu rashladnog sistema. To je zaseban sklop i njena zamena nije povezana sa velikim servisom ni sa zupčastim kaišem. Dijagnostika je pokazala da je kapacitet pumpe opao i da više ne obezbeđuje odgovarajući protok rashladne tečnosti, pa nismo čekali da to počne da utiče na radnu temperaturu motora. Nakon radova sipali smo nov antifriz.

Usput smo uradili i mali servis: zamenili smo motorno ulje i sve potrebne filtere.

Zatim je na red došao menjač. DQ200 je robotizovani menjač sa suvim kvačilima. Zamenili smo ulje u mehaničkom delu i radnu tečnost u mehatronici. Naša preporuka za ovaj menjač je jednostavna: ulje u mehaničkom delu i tečnost u mehatronici menjati najkasnije na svakih **60.000 km**. Uz takav interval održavanja menjač duže traje i ređe zahteva skupe popravke.

src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.2b481f4e754c01fb:
BMW 118d sa dizel motorom N47 i oko **380 000 km** na satu stigao je u naš autoservis u Beogradu. Automobil je uvezen iz Danske, a vlasnik ga je nedavno kupio i odlučio da prvo uradi detaljan servis i otkloni već uočene probleme. To je pravi pristup nakon kupovine polovnog automobila.

Počeli smo kompletnim malim servisom: zamenili smo motorno ulje i sve filtere (ulja, vazduha, kabine i goriva). Kod motora N47 filter goriva zaslužuje posebnu pažnju: od stanja sistema za gorivo direktno zavise ravnomeran rad motora i vek trajanja komponenti tog sistema.

Zatim su na red došli trap i kočnice. Zamenili smo gumene manžetne, kočione diskove i pločice. Kod polovnog automobila sa velikom kilometražom kočnice su među prvim stvarima koje treba proveriti. Ovde je bilo neophodno zameniti istrošene delove kako bi automobil bio bezbedan za dalju vožnju.

Pronašli smo i curenje ulja na zadnjem diferencijalu. Zamenom semeringa zaustavili smo curenje. Kod automobila sa ovolikom kilometražom diferencijal, zaptivke i ostatak pogonskog sklopa zahtevaju posebnu pažnju.

Na 380 000 km ne može sve da se reši jednim dolaskom u servis. Automobil ćemo dovoditi u red postepeno: prvo detaljna dijagnostika i određivanje prioriteta, a zatim radovi na motoru, kočionom sistemu, vešanju i pogonskom sklopu, prema utvrđenom redosledu. Upravo takav pristup preporučujemo nakon kupovine polovnog automobila.

Naši majstori dobro poznaju dizel motore N47. Uz pravilno održavanje, ova kilometraža ne mora da znači da je motor pri kraju radnog veka, ali otklanjanje uočenih problema i redovni servisi ne smeju da se odlažu.

src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.d6aa39e997d5f35e:
This BMW 118d with an N47 diesel engine and around **380,000 km** on the clock came into our workshop in Belgrade. Imported from Denmark, it had recently been bought by its current owner, who decided to start with a comprehensive service and address the issues that had already surfaced. That is the right approach after buying a used car.

We started with a full routine service: engine oil and all filters (oil, air, cabin and fuel). On the N47, the fuel filter deserves particular attention: the condition of the fuel system directly affects how smoothly the engine runs and how long the system's components last.

Next came the running gear and brakes. We replaced the rubber boots, brake discs and pads. Brakes are one of the first things to check on a high-mileage used car, and the worn parts on this one needed replacing to make it safe to drive.

We also found a leak from the rear differential. Replacing the oil seal stopped the loss of lubricant. At this mileage, the differential, seals and the rest of the drivetrain all need careful attention.

At 380,000 km, not everything can be sorted in a single visit. We will get the car back into shape in stages: a thorough inspection, a list of priorities, then work on the engine, braking system, suspension and drivetrain as needed. This is exactly the approach we recommend after buying a used car.

Our technicians know the N47 diesel well. With proper maintenance, this mileage does not mean the engine is at the end of its life, but identified faults need to be addressed promptly and service intervals must be respected.

src/content/works/bmw-b47/index.md.2ecc31d893611a3b:
BMW je stigao u naš ruski auto-servis u Beogradu radi održavanja sistema hlađenja i preventivnih radova na motoru.

Uradili smo delimičnu zamenu rashladne tečnosti. Kod motora **B47** za delimičnu zamenu obično je potrebno **5–7 litara**. Ovog puta sipali smo zelenu rashladnu tečnost Valvoline HT-12.

Usput smo očistili vrtložne klapne i usisni sistem. Kod dizel motora se u usisu i na klapnama vremenom nakupljaju naslage čađi koje ometaju rad motora.

src/content/works/bmw-b47/index.md.f8caa73b78ca48c1:
This BMW came to our Russian-speaking car service in Belgrade for cooling system servicing and preventive engine maintenance.

We carried out a partial coolant change. On **B47** engines, this typically takes **5–7 litres**. This time, we used green Valvoline HT-12 coolant.

We also cleaned the swirl flaps and intake system. On diesel engines, carbon deposits build up in the intake and on the swirl flaps over time, affecting engine performance.

src/content/works/bmw-x3/index.md.3b82d61f81ae827e:
Today we serviced a BMW X3 at our workshop in Belgrade. This is the second routine service we have carried out on this car.

This time, as well as the usual oil and filter change, the customer asked us to change the fluid in the eight-speed **ZF** automatic transmission.

On this transmission, we replace the sump pan along with the fluid. The filter is built into the pan, which also collects wear debris and contaminants. Changing the fluid alone would not constitute a full service for this transmission.

We filled the engine with oil approved to **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04). Using oil with the correct BMW approval is essential.

We also checked the intake swirl flaps. There are no serious issues at this stage, but we advised the customer to have them removed and cleaned at the next routine service.

src/content/works/bmw-x3/index.md.ec2b976485194694:
Danas smo u našem servisu u Beogradu radili servis na BMW-u X3. Ovo je već drugi mali servis koji radimo na ovom automobilu.

Ovog puta klijent je, pored redovne zamene ulja i filtera, tražio i zamenu ulja u osmostepenom automatskom menjaču **ZF**.

Na ovom menjaču ulje menjamo zajedno sa karterom: filter je ugrađen u karter, a u njemu se skupljaju i čestice nastale habanjem i druge nečistoće. Sama zamena ulja nije kompletan servis ovakvog automatskog menjača.

U motor smo sipali ulje sa odobrenjem **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04). Kod BMW-a je ključno da ulje ima odgovarajuće odobrenje.

Usput smo proverili i vrtložne klapne u usisnoj grani. Za sada nema ničeg zabrinjavajućeg, ali smo klijentu preporučili da ih na sledećem malom servisu skinemo i očistimo.

Honda Accord sa benzinskim motorom stigla je u naš autoservis u Beogradu na redovno održavanje.

Zamenili smo motorno ulje i osnovne filtere: filter vazduha, ulja i kabine. Ugradili smo i nove svećice. Od njih zavisi koliko mirno benzinski motor radi, kako pali i koliko goriva troši.

Pored toga, zamenili smo antifriz i kočionu tečnost, koji su važni za održavanje radne temperature motora i pouzdan rad kočnica.

### Koliko često treba menjati ulje u Hondi Accord?

Za benzinsku Hondu Accord preporučujemo zamenu ulja na otprilike **7 500 km**. Ulje postepeno gubi svoja svojstva, a ovaj interval omogućava da motor dobije sveže ulje pre nego što staro prestane da pruža odgovarajuću zaštitu.

Osim zamene ulja, na redovnom servisu treba proveriti i filtere, svećice, antifriz, kočionu tečnost i ostali potrošni materijal.

This petrol-powered Honda Accord came into our workshop in Belgrade for a scheduled service.

We changed the engine oil and replaced the main filters: air, oil and cabin. We also fitted new spark plugs, which affect how smoothly a petrol engine runs, how easily it starts and how much fuel it uses.

We also replaced the coolant and brake fluid, which are essential for keeping the engine at the right operating temperature and ensuring reliable braking.

### How often should you change the oil in a Honda Accord?

For a petrol Accord, we recommend an oil change roughly every **7,500 km**. Oil gradually degrades, and this interval gives the engine fresh oil before the old oil can no longer do its job properly.

Along with changing the oil, a service is a good opportunity to check the filters, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid and other service items.

**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Major service, routine service and gearbox oil change in Belgrade**\
This Peugeot 208 with a 1.2 PureTech petrol engine came to our workshop in Zvezdara for comprehensive maintenance. We carried out a major service (veliki servis), a routine service (mali servis) and a gearbox oil change.\
As part of the major service, we replaced the timing belt and associated components, along with the water pump. On the 1.2 PureTech engine, the water pump is not driven by the timing belt, but we recommend replacing it during a major service. If you choose to keep the existing pump, we strongly recommend replacing at least the separate small belt that drives it.\
Timing belt replacement intervals deserve particular attention on 1.2 PureTech engines. Taking updated recommendations and the characteristics of these engines into account, we recommend a major service every 60,000 km rather than waiting for belt problems to develop. The exact maintenance schedule must be checked for the specific engine variant.\
Our workshop has all the specialist tools needed to carry out a major service correctly on Peugeot and Citroën 1.2 PureTech engines. All work follows the correct procedures for setting and locking the valve timing.\
We also carried out a routine service, replacing the engine oil and filters, and completely changed the gearbox oil using Valvoline oil.

**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Veliki servis, mali servis i zamena ulja u menjaču u Beogradu**\
U naš autoservis na Zvezdari stigao je Peugeot 208 sa benzinskim motorom 1.2 PureTech. Automobilu je bilo potrebno kompletno održavanje, pa smo uradili veliki servis, mali servis i zamenu ulja u menjaču.\
U okviru velikog servisa zamenili smo zupčasti kaiš i prateće delove, kao i vodenu pumpu. Na motoru 1.2 PureTech vodenu pumpu ne pokreće zupčasti kaiš, ali preporučujemo da se i ona zameni prilikom velikog servisa. Ako odlučite da zadržite staru pumpu, svakako preporučujemo da zamenite makar zaseban mali kaiš koji je pokreće.\
Posebnu pažnju treba obratiti na intervale zamene zupčastog kaiša kod motora 1.2 PureTech. Uzimajući u obzir ažurirane preporuke i specifičnosti ovih motora, preporučujemo veliki servis na svakih 60 000 km, pre nego što se pojave problemi sa kaišem. Tačan interval održavanja treba proveriti za konkretnu verziju motora.\
Naš autoservis poseduje sav potreban specijalni alat za pravilno obavljanje velikog servisa na motorima Peugeot i Citroën 1.2 PureTech. Sve radove izvodimo uz poštovanje propisanog postupka uzupčenja i blokiranja razvoda.\

src/content/works/vw-golf/index.md.4a7c05f5f063a278:
A 2017 Volkswagen Golf with a 7-speed **DSG DQ381** dual-clutch transmission came to our workshop in Belgrade for comprehensive servicing and repairs to several faults.

We replaced the valve cover to fix an oil leak, renewed the fuel injector seals, carried out an interim engine service, changed the DSG transmission oil and filter, and cleaned the brake calipers.

We paid particular attention to the DSG DQ381 gearbox. This modern 7-speed dual-clutch transmission needs timely oil and filter changes. Over time, the oil degrades and wear particles accumulate, affecting the operation of the mechatronic unit, hydraulic system and clutches. Regular oil changes help maintain smooth gear shifts and reduce the risk of expensive DSG repairs.

We filled the gearbox with **MOTUL** transmission oil meeting the required specification and used MOTUL oil for the engine as well. The quality of both engine and transmission oil directly affects the vehicle's service life.

As part of the interim service, we changed the engine oil and the required filters. Timely oil changes are especially important for Volkswagen turbocharged engines: the oil lubricates components, carries heat away and protects the turbocharger from premature wear.

We replaced the valve cover because the old one was leaking oil. These leaks tend to worsen over time, leaving oil and grime on the engine. We also renewed the fuel injector seals, as leak-free connections are essential for safe fuel system operation.

We also cleaned dirt and corrosion from the brake calipers. When moving parts seize, they can cause uneven brake pad wear, overheated discs and unusual noises during braking.
src/content/works/vw-golf/index.md.a78b7cf1964a400f:
Volkswagen Golf iz 2017. godine sa 7-stepenim menjačem sa dvostrukim kvačilom **DSG DQ381** stigao je u naš autoservis u Beogradu na detaljno održavanje i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova.

Tokom servisa zamenili smo poklopac ventila zbog curenja ulja, zamenili zaptivke dizni, uradili mali servis motora, zamenili ulje i filter u DSG menjaču i očistili kočiona klešta.

Posebnu pažnju posvetili smo menjaču DSG DQ381. To je savremen 7-stepeni menjač sa dvostrukim kvačilom, kod kojeg je važno redovno menjati ulje i filter. Ulje vremenom gubi svoja svojstva, a u njemu se nakupljaju čestice nastale habanjem, što utiče na rad mehatronike, hidrauličnog sistema i kvačila. Redovna zamena ulja omogućava glatko menjanje brzina i smanjuje rizik od skupih popravki DSG menjača.

U menjač smo sipali **MOTUL** ulje odgovarajuće specifikacije, a i za motor smo koristili MOTUL. Kvalitet motornog i menjačkog ulja direktno utiče na vek trajanja automobila.

U okviru malog servisa zamenili smo motorno ulje i potrebne filtere. Kod Volkswagenovih turbo motora pravovremena zamena ulja posebno je važna: ulje podmazuje delove, odvodi toplotu i štiti turbinu od prevremenog habanja.

Poklopac ventila zamenili smo jer je stari počeo da propušta ulje. Takva curenja vremenom postaju sve izraženija i dovode do prljanja motora. Ujedno smo zamenili i zaptivke dizni, jer je dobro zaptivanje spojeva važno za bezbedan rad sistema za gorivo.

Sa kočionih klešta uklonili smo prljavštinu i koroziju. Kada pokretni delovi zapeknu, dolazi do neravnomernog habanja pločica, pregrevanja diskova i neobičnih zvukova pri kočenju.

src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.649040604d3d7758:
Zamena ulja u **DSG DQ381** menjaču je deo održavanja koji ne treba zanemarivati.

Ovog puta smo radili redovnu zamenu: klijent je izabrao ulje **MEYLE**, sipali smo ga i obavili ostale potrebne radove u sklopu servisa.

DQ381 je savremeni sedmostepeni DSG menjač sa dvostrukim kvačilom u uljnom kupatilu, koji se ugrađuje u mnoge modele marki Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda i SEAT. Uz pravovremeno održavanje, ovaj menjač može dugo da radi bez ozbiljnih problema.

Isto važi i za druge česte DSG menjače, DQ250 i DQ200. Konstrukcija i servisni intervali se razlikuju, ali stanje ulja i pravovremeno održavanje direktno utiču na vek menjača, rad mehatronike i kvačila.

Savetujemo da se ne vodite samo propisanim servisnim intervalima, već i stvarnim uslovima vožnje. Ako servisna istorija nije poznata, nikako ne treba voziti 100–150 hiljada kilometara sa istim uljem. Na svakih **100 000 km** ima smisla barem proveriti kada je i kako menjač održavan, a kod DQ381 i DQ250 ulje je uglavnom preporučljivo menjati znatno ranije.

Sveže, kvalitetno ulje zadržava potrebna svojstva pri različitim temperaturama i opterećenjima, podmazuje i odvodi toplotu. Time se odlaže potreba za skupim popravkama.

Kupili ste polovan automobil i ne znate kada je poslednji put servisiran DSG DQ381, DQ250 ili DQ200? Proverite stanje menjača i njegovu servisnu istoriju na vreme.
src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.6e89670e4fd967bf:
Changing the oil in a **DSG DQ381** is a part of gearbox maintenance that is best not neglected.

This time, we carried out a scheduled oil change. The customer chose **MEYLE** oil, which we used while completing the rest of the required service work.

The DQ381 is a modern seven-speed DSG dual-clutch transmission with wet clutches, fitted to many Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda and SEAT models. With timely servicing, it can last a long time without major problems.

The same principle applies to the other common DSG transmissions, the DQ250 and DQ200. Their designs and service schedules differ, but oil condition and timely maintenance directly affect gearbox life and the operation of the mechatronic unit and clutches.

We recommend considering actual driving conditions, not just the official service schedule. If the service history is unknown, driving 100,000-150,000 km on the same oil is certainly not advisable. At least every **100,000 km**, it is worth checking when and how the gearbox was serviced. For the DQ381 and DQ250, changing the oil considerably sooner usually makes sense.

Fresh, high-quality oil maintains its properties across a range of temperatures and loads, providing lubrication and carrying heat away. This helps keep expensive repairs at bay.

Bought a used car and don't know when its DSG DQ381, DQ250 or DQ200 was last serviced? Have the gearbox's condition and service history checked before problems develop.
